text:
lina-m: Heads up — candidate for Staff ML Eng (Luhani Patel) just emailed: flight delayed, ETA now ~11:30am. Loop is 10:00–13:00 onsite. Can we shift panels or use remote fallback?

omar-k: Which interviews are strictly in-person? I can go remote if needed.

maddie: I booked Conf A for 10:00 already. If we go remote we should notify front desk + panel. Also can we move lunch?

alex-r: I can slide my panel to 12:30 if that helps, but prefer onsite final. Is there a quiet space if they arrive and need to rest?

lina-m: Plan suggestion: keep 10:00 tentative, create Meet link as backup, reserve Quiet Room B 11:00–14:00, and pre-create visitor badge + loaner laptop. @frontdesk-bot can you pre-register Luhani Patel?

frontdesk-bot: Pre-registration created for "Luhani Patel" — badge will be at reception under her name. Parking: Visitor permit in Lot C (permit code emailed to candidate).

calendar-bot: Backup Google Meet created: https://meet.google.com/xyz-abcq. Added join link to all invites and reserved Quiet Room B 11:00–14:00.

lina-m: If candidate still in the air at 09:45 we'll run first two interviews remote and keep the final onsite at 12:30 if they arrive. @omar-k @maddie please confirm you can pivot.

omar-k: :thumbsup: I can pivot to remote for my slot.

maddie: :+1: can run remote first two too.

alex-r: If candidate needs ADA accommodations we have noise-cancelling headphones + accessible table in Quiet Room B. Also approve taxi coverage if they miss their connection?

lina-m: Yes — people ops will cover taxi up to $100. Candidate should email receipts to hr@redwood.ai. I'll DM them travel instructions and the stipend form.

lina-m: I'll post the candidate-facing blurb and the panel note. Here's the template I'll send to both (posting for visibility):

```
Candidate message:
Hi Luhani — sorry to hear about the delay. We can run your interviews remotely if you're still traveling; we'll keep one slot open for an onsite final at ~12:30 if you make it. Please use this Meet link to join: https://meet.google.com/xyz-abcq and let me know if you need a taxi stipend — we can cover up to $100 (send receipts to hr@redwood.ai). If you arrive early, Quiet Room B is reserved 11:00–14:00 and your visitor badge will be at reception.

Panel message:
Team — FYI candidate may be delayed. Backup Meet link has been added to the calendar. Quiet Room B reserved 11:00–14:00. Please be prepared to pivot to remote for the first two interviews; we'll keep the final at 12:30 in-person if candidate arrives. Contact Lina (x412) if anything changes.
```

maddie: Sent to candidate at 09:12 — candidate replied "Thanks — I'll aim for remote if still delayed."

frontdesk-bot: Badge printed and on-hold at reception for "Luhani Patel".

lina-m: Great, thanks everyone. I'll update the calendar events with the final plan at 09:30 and close the loop here.

alex-r: Thanks — appreciate the quick pivot.

lina-m: Closing loop — candidate ended up arriving 12:05, we ran remote first two, final onsite at 12:30 worked. Taxi covered and receipt done. :white_check_mark:
